puzzle.body: Group options by subcommands Having all the options in one place _rather than grouping them by subcommands_ makes the help totally misleading and hard to read. Not all the options are valid for every command - that's the key here. The option below (`--max-nodes`) is an example. **Next actions:** - Implement the suggestion above. - Remove note from the --max-nodes option saying that it applies to the select subcommand only.
